summary.description: One line on what the fixes of this Attempt changed, written like a commit subject.

handoff.description: What the next agent on this Ticket needs to know: what is done, what is left, and where you got stuck.

door.description: Whether the change can be walked back after the merge.

blast_radius.description: One word for the scope of the change, such as local, module, cross-module or public.

danger_notes.description: The ramifications of the merge the owner should know, or an empty string.

standards.description: The report of the Standards sub-agent.

spec.description: The report of the Spec sub-agent.

reason.description: What the fix did, or why the finding was left.
